  "regular": {

    "start": 10000,

  },
  "ephemeral": {
    "start": 20000,
    "end": 29999,
    "description": "Ephemeral events - forwarded but not stored"
  },

    "start": 30000,
    "end": 39999,
    "description": "Parameterized replaceable - replaced by d tag value"
  }
};
export const PRIVILEGED_KINDS = [4, 13, 14, 15, 1059, 1060, 30078];
export const DIRECTORY_KINDS = [0, 3, 5, 1984, 10002, 10000, 10050];

// Lookup map for fast access
const kindMap = new Map(EVENT_KINDS.map(k => [k.kind, k]));
export function getKindInfo(kind) {
  return kindMap.get(kind);
}
export function getKindName(kind) {
  const info = kindMap.get(kind);
  return info ? info.name : `Kind ${kind}`;
}
export function isReplaceable(kind) {
  if (kind === 0 || kind === 3) return true;
  return kind >= KIND_RANGES.replaceable.start && kind < KIND_RANGES.replaceable.end;
}
export function isEphemeral(kind) {
  return kind >= KIND_RANGES.ephemeral.start && kind < KIND_RANGES.ephemeral.end;
}
export function isParameterized(kind) {
  return kind >= KIND_RANGES.parameterized.start && kind <= KIND_RANGES.parameterized.end;
}
export function isPrivileged(kind) {
  return PRIVILEGED_KINDS.includes(kind);
}
export function isDirectoryKind(kind) {
  return DIRECTORY_KINDS.includes(kind);
